workflow_candidates.name: Restaurant issue → verified closure
workflow_candidates.trigger: Staff sends a photo/voice note about a leaking freezer.
sequence: Capture source IDs, outlet, media and coverage.
Locate the asset; ask a targeted question if uncertain.
Propose issue with observed evidence, not an invented diagnosis.
Manager accepts scope, assignee and expected completion proof.
Track acknowledgment, blockers and due time.
Manager reviews follow-up evidence and closes the issue; preserve recurrence history.
workflow_candidates.authority: Existing operations process during shadowing; GoFathom tasks only after explicit cutover.
workflow_candidates.why: Sidekick’s low-friction capture and herdr’s attention view may reduce forgotten work.
workflow_candidates.test: Measure unreported/missed eligible issues, correct asset routing, review minutes, acknowledgment and closure time. No demand or percentage gain established.
workflow_candidates.boundary: A photo cannot prove hidden electrical, hygiene or safety conditions.

workflow_candidates.name: Receiving / invoice → reviewed exception
workflow_candidates.buyer: Restaurant owner, purchasing lead or accountant
workflow_candidates.trigger: Delivery note says 10 crates; receiving photo/voice suggests 8; invoice bills 10.
sequence: Link order, receiving evidence and invoice without merging their meanings.
Normalize item, unit and period using reviewed mappings.
Run exact quantity/value checks in code.
Show discrepancy or CANNOT_VERIFY with missing evidence.
Reviewer confirms accepted receipt and next follow-up.
Track supplier response/credit and reconcile with the authoritative accounting record.
workflow_candidates.authority: Customer stock/accounting system; GoFathom owns exception and review history unless a ledger migration is separately agreed.
workflow_candidates.why: Marble supplies domain separation; Asakana supplies focused corrections; Definite supplies exact checks.
workflow_candidates.test: Measure discrepancy precision/recall, material missed amounts, reconciliation time and all reviewer/operator minutes.
workflow_candidates.boundary: No automatic payment, duplicate inventory posting or assumption that invoice quantity equals received stock.

workflow_candidates.name: Court email → reviewed matter work
workflow_candidates.buyer: Principal and Ramya as operational user
workflow_candidates.trigger: Court sends a notice, followed later by a correction.
sequence: Capture email, attachment, source revision and inbox coverage.
Match jurisdiction/court/matter identity; unresolved cases enter an ambiguous lane.
Extract cited date and type as a proposal; do not infer a statutory deadline.
Ramya verifies the notice and assigns the appropriate staff member.
Staff receives only matter-authorized evidence and acknowledges work.
Corrected notice reopens review and revises dependent reminders; completion needs the required document/filing evidence.
workflow_candidates.authority: Existing legal process and reviewed source notices remain authoritative during shadowing.
workflow_candidates.why: Praxis contributes matter-centered coordination; Glen suggests permission-aware context.
workflow_candidates.test: Measure missed eligible notices, wrong matter matches, unsupported dates, acknowledgment and review time by risk class.

change_classes.name: One-off record correction
change_classes.mechanism: Authorize editor; bind evidence and record revision; append correction; rerun dependent checks; show affected tasks. No standing rule is inferred.
change_classes.release: Record-level acceptance and audit; compensate downstream effects when needed.

change_classes.name: Operational instruction
change_classes.example: Hold new orders from this supplier until Friday.
change_classes.mechanism: Verify issuer/scope; confirm effective time, expiry and affected action classes; activate C15; invalidate pending incompatible proposals. Forwarded messages are evidence, not authority.
change_classes.release: Operational confirmation, conflict resolution and expiry; no model training cycle.

change_classes.name: Tenant dictionary or rule
change_classes.example: For this supplier, one crate of this SKU contains 12 units.
change_classes.mechanism: Preview historical and plausible future impacts; distinguish packaging/date versions; reviewer signs scoped rule. High-impact identity, quantity or financial rules need targeted regression/holdout tests.
change_classes.release: Versioned activation, limited rollout and rollback; tenant-only is not automatically low risk.

change_classes.name: Reusable product / model change
change_classes.example: A revised parser handles mixed-language delivery notes.
change_classes.mechanism: Use consented/minimized examples; isolate tenant data; pin parser/prompt/model; run protected regression, fault and holdout suites. Training is optional, not assumed.
change_classes.release: Release report, canary, rollback and incident monitoring; never let the acting model promote itself.

roadmap.name: Access, baseline & product choice
roadmap.deliver: Audit actual code and access. Observe current work; list eligible source events, gaps, reviewer time and consequences. Compare the three candidate workflows where data exists, select one and make a priced pilot offer. Produce the H/C code-audit table at a pinned commit and record reproduction outcomes (not yet attempted, reproduced, not reproducible, or blocked by rights/availability). Select required modalities and record buyer relationship/demand evidence.
roadmap.gate: Named buyer, reviewer, source authority and allowed exposure; usable consented sources; frozen versioned pilot terms and review/risk budget. Bounded discovery may precede a paid commitment. Resolve unavailable access before broad implementation.
roadmap.time: Two-week discovery/shadow timebox below; not a promise of a finished product.

roadmap.name: Foundation & read-only shadow
roadmap.deliver: Identity/grants, one connector, durable intake, evidence storage, source coverage, candidate lanes and protected fixtures. Run beside the existing process. Add independent inventory provenance, complete processing accounting, C17 bindings, worker profiles and a named runner owner/charter.
roadmap.gate: Reconcile eligible-event denominator; no silent gaps; cross-tenant/revocation controls pass; compare omissions and reviewer minutes to manual work.
roadmap.time: Estimate after code/access audit. A shadow prototype does not certify reliance.

roadmap.name: Reviewed work, one complete loop
roadmap.deliver: Evidence drawer, accept/correct/hold, one domain schema, acknowledged assignments, closure proof and C15 instruction history. Cut over only explicitly scoped internal records. Add exact override/time semantics, review queue aging/backups and external-revision stale-check propagation.
roadmap.gate: Owner accepts field results and workload; disagreement/unknown items remain visible; changed evidence propagates; correction rollback works.
roadmap.time: Prioritize the smallest usable loop, not all 76 planning packages.

roadmap.name: First authorized external action
roadmap.deliver: Choose one action type. Implement exact approval, gateway, idempotency, effect ledger, readback, reconciliation and kill switch. Serialize claims/transmit markers with grant/cancel epochs; a scoped stop lists in-flight effects and uses truthful verified/unknown labels. Prefer an action with provider idempotency or reliable readback; include unresolved-outcome review cost in the choice.
roadmap.gate: Pass the declarative FT04/FT05 scenarios in a real implementation, including stale-worker/bypass paths. Enable only an expressly approved action/risk slice after a documented assurance review.
roadmap.time: No automatic purchasing, payment or legal deadline inference as a first action.

roadmap.name: Reliability, economics & paid operation
roadmap.deliver: Restore rehearsal, incident response, support ownership, source recovery, cost attribution, constrained rollout and rollback. Confirm a paid service/product boundary.
roadmap.gate: Agreed risk/coverage/review targets hold over representative operation; total cost and support burden fit the offer; unresolved critical incidents block expansion.
roadmap.time: Duration follows event coverage and failure evidence, not an arbitrary calendar.

roadmap.name: Expand from observed pull
roadmap.deliver: Add a second workflow or source only with evidence. Qualify optional desktop capture, advanced retrieval, video, delegated operators and agent-to-agent exchange separately.
roadmap.gate: Incremental value exceeds integration/review cost and regressions pass; new privacy and authority boundaries are designed before rollout.
roadmap.time: Native collaboration and WhatsApp replacement remain optional long-term directions.

failure_tests.stimulus: Replay one source revision twice; leave another pending; quarantine one; exclude one with a rule; let one message create three candidates and a burst support one candidate.
failure_tests.expected: Captured source revisions reconcile once across pending/excluded/quarantined/failed/assessed states. Candidate links are many-to-many; no excluded event disappears from audit.

failure_tests.case: FT02 · Independent denominator and canary limits
failure_tests.stimulus: Remove an eligible event before journal capture and another at routing; compare a separately sourced inventory. Include shared-failure and unknown-inventory variants.
failure_tests.expected: Report observed omission or unknown denominator. Labeled real-event recall and known canary detection are separate; processing reconciliation alone never proves source completeness.

failure_tests.stimulus: Change an external field after a check is proposed and before admission/writeback; edit the former authority after cutover.
failure_tests.expected: Stale bound check cannot authorize overwriting the new value. Re-read/review or reconcile; dual-authority edits raise a visible exception.

failure_tests.case: FT04 · Revoke and cancel at each boundary
failure_tests.stimulus: Revoke before claim, after claim/before send, during send, after remote commit and after lost receipt; race two dispatchers.
failure_tests.expected: No claim after committed scope stop. Earlier claims receive truthful prevented/requested/verified-cancelled/completed/unknown labels. At most one valid local claim per intent generation; provider effects reconciled.

failure_tests.stimulus: Provider commits then times out; a retry arrives; later compensation is requested.
failure_tests.expected: No blind duplicate action; reconcile first. Compensation requires its own current authorization and receipt. Unknown is never silently relabeled failed or cancelled.

failure_tests.stimulus: Apply a supplier hold; propose narrower subordinate release; use “until Friday” without boundary; supersede after dispatch claim.
failure_tests.expected: Unauthorized release and ambiguous boundary are held. Explicit authorized overrides trace their target; prospective rules do not undo an already emitted effect. A model cannot invent a preauthorized instruction policy entry; affected-work preview names its coverage limits.

failure_tests.case: FT07 · Review backlog and exact confirmation
failure_tests.stimulus: Exceed planned review capacity; submit two similar proposals; issue an ambiguous “OK”.
failure_tests.expected: Backlog and age remain visible, escalation has an owner and nothing auto-accepts. Ambiguous confirmation binds to no proposal until clarified. Critical work is not hidden by budget caps.

failure_tests.stimulus: Crash after lease claim; run a stale worker; restart a timer; deploy an unknown job definition; request a new unsupported orchestration primitive.
failure_tests.expected: Fence stale worker, preserve bounded timer/retry progress, hold unsupported definitions and trigger a runner/engine review. Reconcile effect uncertainty outside retry guessing.

failure_tests.case: FT09 · Parser boundary and source minimization
failure_tests.stimulus: Attempt prohibited file/network access and resource exhaustion; inject nonselected chat content into a controlled adapter fixture; inspect storage/log/cache/crash paths.
failure_tests.expected: Permitted derivative still works; prohibited access is denied. Document actual prefilter exposure and measured persistence. Reject a deployment whose agreed privacy boundary cannot be met.

failure_tests.case: FT10 · Frozen experiment and model qualification
failure_tests.stimulus: Change eligibility after results, swap model/parser, use unavailable observer and expose oracle answers to acting model.
failure_tests.expected: Original results remain; amended experiment has new digest/window. Model swap reruns qualified cases; unobservable episode is ungradable; oracle leakage invalidates evaluation. A changed or expired reliance decision prevents expansion of the allowed automation scope.

failure_tests.stimulus: A CA/operator switches businesses, reuses a cached result and then loses one grant; try sharing under a common owner.
failure_tests.expected: Active context and current scoped grants govern reads/exports; cache key and invalidation cannot substitute for authorization. Cross-business disclosure needs an explicit allowed purpose.

failure_tests.stimulus: Feed permitted blurred photo, noisy Hinglish audio, text-only email and sampled video as required by the chosen workflow.
failure_tests.expected: Return supported cited candidates or visible uncertainty; modality coverage and wrong-extraction/abstention reported per risk slice; no unsupported hidden-condition inference.

cost.status: Illustrative assumptions, not quotes or validated prices.
cost.formula: vendor cash = fixed + model + media + storage + provider review + support; customer burden = subscription + customer review value; combined resources = vendor cash + customer review value (subscription excluded as transfer)
notes: All source volumes and review hours are totals across the businesses; price and business count calculate subscription revenue. Price is a placeholder for sensitivity analysis, not a G0 pricing anchor.

Provider/operator review belongs in vendor cash only when GoFathom pays it. Customer review is opportunity cost at an explicit valuation, not an automatic cash expense. Do not count the same reviewer twice.
Vendor contribution = subscription revenue minus modeled vendor cash; excludes taxes, sales, founder salaries, onboarding and omitted costs. It is not net profit.
Customer burden = subscription plus customer review opportunity cost; benefit has not been measured. Combined resource cost excludes subscription because it is a transfer between the parties.
Cost per verified completion uses genuinely completed outcomes; zero completions is undefined. Simulated/default values never establish real margins or improvement.

complexity.baseline: O(N) scan; naive all-pairs matching O(N²)
complexity.approach: Indexed exact lookup O(log N + k), then bounded candidate checks
complexity.limit: Fuzzy matching can still approach all-pairs behavior; cap candidates and measure ambiguity.

complexity.baseline: Repeated work on every redelivery; no bounded completion guarantee
complexity.approach: B-tree identity lookup/insert O(log E); O(E) total retained events
complexity.limit: Database contention, revisions and retention alter real throughput; stable provider identity is required.

complexity.baseline: Send all retained history, O(T) tokens per request
complexity.approach: Retrieve k relevant items, bound assembled tokens B; permission checks on all selected items
complexity.space: O(N) search index plus bounded per-run context
complexity.limit: No constant-time retrieval guarantee; loss of recall must be measured. LLM attention cost depends on model implementation.

complexity.baseline: Process all F frames or whole assets at full resolution
complexity.approach: Process selected f frames or relevant regions, f ≤ F
complexity.limit: Work often scales with processed bytes/frames but sampling may miss events; no accuracy equivalence assumed.

complexity.baseline: Repeated full scan of all tasks N
complexity.approach: Index by tenant/status/due time: O(log N + k) for page or due batch
complexity.limit: Worst-case many due tasks still require O(N) work; fair scheduling and concurrency limits matter.

complexity.baseline: Long AI computation while holding locks
complexity.approach: AI outside transaction; short conditional update and transactional outbox
complexity.limit: Retries under contention and remote latency remain; no global exactly-once claim.

critique.instructions: Critique Foundation 1.1 against its preserved 1.0 predecessor and the adjudication ledger. Decisions and declarative tests remain proposals. Do not treat agreement between Codex and Claude as empirical validation.
protocol: Read llms-full.txt and blueprint.json; use stable GF-D, stage, layer, H and C IDs.
For each objection cite the exact decision, assumption and source or mark it as a hypothesis.
Give the strongest alternative, user benefit, new failure modes and maintenance/operational cost.
Specify a falsifiable test and the observation that would change the decision.
Distinguish blocker, pilot experiment, later optimization and unsupported preference.
Preserve hard grants, protected oracles and equivalent safeguards in every comparison arm.
Do not invent performance percentages, customer demand, completed integrations or legal conclusions.
Return a proposed change set with accepted/rejected/deferred recommendations and unresolved disagreements.
Check whether accepted refinements are propagated across stages, layers, contracts and tests.
Keep source gaps, processing gaps, candidate matching, admission and effect outcome as separate dimensions.
Read debate.json for qualified/rejected recommendations; challenge remaining assumptions with falsifiable evidence.
